version-output: version prints the package.json version and exits 0
unknown-subcommand-exit: unknown subcommand exits 64 and prints usage to stderr
init-creates-fleet-layout: init creates the fleet layout and a git repo with a bootstrap commit
init-refuses-reinit: init on an initialized fleet exits nonzero and reports already initialized
init-refuses-non-empty-dir: init refuses a non-empty directory that is not a fleet home
init-gitignore-narrowed: init gitignore tracks durable areas and ignores ephemera
init-machine-identity-commit: init bootstrap commit uses the machine identity without global git config
init-usage-error: init without a directory argument exits 64
doctor-per-check-lines: doctor in a healthy fleet prints one line per check with no unexpected FAIL
doctor-healthy-exit-zero: doctor in a healthy fleet exits 0
doctor-layout-missing-fail: doctor after deleting decisions reports CHECK layout FAIL naming the missing entry
doctor-non-fleet-nonzero: doctor outside a fleet home exits nonzero
doctor-gh-warn-generic: doctor reports CHECK gh WARN when gh is absent from PATH
doctor-gh-absent-generic-exit-zero: doctor with gh absent exits 0 under the generic profile
doctor-gh-fail-full-profile: doctor --for full promotes gh-missing to FAIL
doctor-remote-fail-full-profile: doctor --for full promotes remote-missing to FAIL
doctor-beacon-fail-watch-profile: doctor --for watch promotes beacon-absent to FAIL
doctor-lock-corrupt-fail: doctor reports CHECK lock FAIL on a corrupt lease file
doctor-lock-unparseable-expiry-fail: doctor reports CHECK lock FAIL when the lease expiresAt does not parse
doctor-node-range-fail-closed: node range evaluation compares full versions and fails closed on uninterpretable ranges
init-refuses-file-collision: init on a path that is an existing file exits 1 with a single reason line
doctor-lock-reports-holder: doctor reports holder and expiry for a readable lease
doctor-unknown-profile-usage: doctor --for with an unknown profile exits 64
